jobs.description: The OpportunityWe are looking for an SAP HANA Performance Team Leader to plan, execute, and validate the performance of SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV and AOS. Serve as a subject matter expert to support performance teams in qualifying and certifying our solution.- Analyze results from SAP validation and certification suites, compare them to SAP's KPI thresholds, diagnose failures, and drive issues to root cause across the full stack.- Provision, configure, and troubleshoot SAP HANA parameters, SLES/RHEL for SAP tuning, vCPU/NUMA topology, kernel scheduling, general storage topologies, virtual storage controllers, and network fabrics.- Experience with automating hardware and software deployments, infrastructure as code, and APIs.- Ability to explore how AI can be used to automate processes further using advanced AI models.- Understand the impact of new CPU and memory innovations on SAP HANA workloads and how Nutanix AHV and AOS must evolve to achieve performance benchmarks close to bare metal.- Understand both scale-up and scale-out HANA and other key architectures of the SAP HANA database.- Assist in producing written artifacts including SAP Notes, best practice guides, test plans, and KPI result packages for SAP submissions.- Develop sizing guidelines, configuration recommendations, and reference architectures for SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV/AOS.- Help customers and Nutanix sellers on large deals involving SAP HANA.- Work with hardware OEMs to enable them to achieve their own hardware validations for SAP HANA with Nutanix.- Linux OS experience- Experience with Nutanix HCI- Performance monitoring tools- Hands-on experience running SAP HANA test harness validation and certification suites, interpreting KPI results,
